correctness.rationale: Each mod-p factorization was checked coefficientwise from the integral polynomial. At p=3 the smooth conic has precisely four F3-tangent lines and six pairwise distinct line intersections; inclusion-exclusion yields the all-extension count. At p=5 the three explicit partial derivatives exhaust four nodes and six cusps. The node tangent cone is nondegenerate with F5-nonsquare discriminant 3; Bezout and the delta-genus calculation give geometrically integral rational normalization, with F5-point supplied by a cusp. Accounting for Frobenius-swapped node branches yields N_n=5^n+1-4(-1)^n. Signed permutations and the four-point frame prove both full S4 projective stabilizers. Standalone exact verifier confirms identities and six finite fields, while infinite n is proved algebraically.

originality.rationale: The new assessed assertion is the complete zeta-function calculation for the three bad fibres of the exact Wiman plane sextic model, especially the nonsplit four-node correction over F5. Primary literature gives the underlying equation and qualitative degeneration; an existing generalized Wiman–Edge classification covers the geometric 4A1+6A2 stratum and is not treated as novel. That geometric statement does not determine the Frobenius action on node branches and hence does not imply the characteristic-five zeta numerator. Targeted research-record and literature searches found no equivalent formula. Priority is not certified and an older calculation remains possible.

value.rationale: The arithmetic zeta function of the bad fibres of a canonical highly symmetric plane model is a natural exact invariant: it governs all extension-field point counts and records distinctions not visible from the geometric normalization or singularity basket. The parity dependence at p=5 reflects a genuinely arithmetic split/nonsplit phenomenon. The three exceptional characteristics form a complete motivated boundary of the standard good-characteristic Wiman analysis, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The geometric four-node/six-cusp classification itself is acknowledged as prior and is not assigned novel value.
